name: Sonoran desert tortoise
desc: A herbivore that eats mostly grasses and wildflowers, plus cactus fruit and growth. Eggs and young are taken by ravens, badgers and coyotes.
about: The Sonoran Desert tortoise, or Morafka's desert tortoise, is a species of terrestrial chelonian reptile of the family Testudinidae (tortoises) native to the Sonoran Desert.
